from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow data from one company's quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in this filing")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="The operating cash flow amount as reported; negative values indicate negative cash flow")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, if specified")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the cash flow figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
